seller_or_subject: JC Lynne — creator: Stripe payout nightmare
what: Creator describes Patreon and Stripe payout relationship as a "nightmare"; changed banks and could not update payout account because old account number was required.
verbatim_snippet: "Patreon and its relationship with Stripe have been a nightmare. On my end, I changed banks and forgot to update my payout account. I tried to update it and didn't have the old account number...."
notes: Truncated on listing page. Creator perspective confirmed ("my payout account"). 2-star rating.
